t: Four words before, and what they cover
a: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنِي الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
p: Bismi-Llāh. Allāhumma jannibni-sh-shayṭān, wa jannibi-sh-shayṭāna mā razaqtanā
m: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from me, and keep Satan away from what You provide us.
